Senescence is induced by 4OHT-activated ER:RAS and the series does not state any senescence marker. Samples treated with cardiac glycosides (senolytics) or with caspase inhibitor are excluded; only the vehicle +4OHT samples are senescent and only the vehicle -4OHT samples are controls.

SuperSeries mixing IMR90 ER:RAS cultures (4OHT-induced oncogene senescence, 6 days) with mouse liver tissue; no sample is treated as a senescent condition in the tissue part. Caspase-inhibitor samples and cardiac-glycoside (digoxin/ouabain, senolytic) samples are excluded; only the vehicle +4OHT samples without caspase inhibitor are senescent and -4OHT vehicle are controls.

No senescence was induced and no sample is described as senescent; the dataset compares WT and RAP1-knockout ES-derived MSCs and NSCs at early passage (p2/p3). All samples are therefore excluded as having no senescent condition.

The fields do not say which BJ_ras samples were collected at the senescent state (no dox or time point given), so BJ_ras and BJ controls are unclear. Clone 8 samples are titled clone_8 but their source name says clone 6.

Passage (early or late) is not given for any sample, so no sample can be assigned as senescent or control. The senescence work in the summary (proteomics, metabolic flux) is not part of these RNA-seq sample fields.

The series text does not say which samples are senescent or give any senescence assay. Samples mix cultured hMSCs, a cultured human liver cell line of unknown senescence state, and mouse tissue (not cultured). Only WS-sgNTC is labelled senescent, by inference from the series' progeroid-syndrome senescence models.

No sample is stated to be senescent: UV samples are 12 h acute stress and the replicative-stress MSCs (passage 28) are only called 'replicative senescence stress', so these are labelled unclear. Mut vs gene-corrected (GC) lines differ in ERCC6 genotype; iPSCs are pluripotent lines, not controls.

Replicative senescence (passage 36) vs young (passage 24) WI-38, with RNA-seq and Ribo-seq libraries. Heat-shock samples are labelled excluded as an added perturbation; no senescence marker assay is stated in the series text.
Single MII oocytes from women of different ages (young vs advanced maternal age), taken from patients; no senescence induction or senescent condition, so these are not senescence samples.

The series says EWS-FLI1 causes replication stress that can result in senescence but never states that senescence was reached at any passage, so EWS-FLI1 and Vector samples without the library are unclear. Samples with the 26-ORF overexpression library are excluded as perturbed.

confirmation_stated: up-regulation of senescence-associated beta-galactosidase; growth arrest after a mean of 21 (MSC) and 17 (iMSC) cumulative population doublings; senescence-associated DNA methylation changes; morphology changes
note: Replicative senescence at P11 in primary MSCs and in iPSC-derived MSCs (iMSCs, re-differentiated from reprogrammed MSCs of the same donors); early passages (P2 MSC, P5 iMSC) are the controls. Donors are paired across the four groups.

confirmation_stated: proliferation arrest on BRAFV600E expression (antagonized by DNMT3B), as a hallmark of oncogene-induced senescence
note: The BRAF OIS time point is not stated. DNMT3B-overexpressing samples are labelled excluded as perturbations, and the summary says DNMT3B opposes BRAF-induced arrest. The vector/vector samples are empty-vector controls of both constructs.

Time of collection after the one-hour pulse is not stated in the fields. Doxorubicin samples are labelled senescent as the comparator senescence response named in the series, but the summary does not state their senescent state outright.

Reactive-astrocyte samples (TNFa+IL1a, IL1b) are a distinct non-senescent activation state, so they are labelled excluded (other) rather than controls. The senescent label for rotenone and H2O2 rests on the series calling them senescence-inducing; no senescence marker is given in the fields.
The series describes drug-persister (SUR) cells after PLX4032 and never says they are senescent, so both samples are unclear; the parental cells are an untreated control of that unclear condition.

Sample titles of GSM3625671/72/78/79/85/86 say '5 days' but the 4OHT-days characteristic says 8; the characteristic was used. The series does not name the senescent time point, so the last one (8 days) was taken as senescent and ER:RAS 5-day non-target samples as intermediate.

Senescent decidual cells are only a subpopulation within the decidualising stromal cultures, so no sample is a plain senescent or control sample; time-course samples are labelled unclear and biopsies excluded as tissue. Decidualisation is the differentiation signal, not a classic senescence inducer.

Senescence is induced by LSG1 knockdown (siRNA; the summary says shLSG1) or KRAS overexpression in MRC5 cells. No time points are stated, and the KRAS samples have no vector control. Controls are control-siRNA samples.

Senescence is inferred from the series text (bleomycin-induced DNA damage giving a typical SASP); no senescence marker assay is stated. The bleomycin plus ML324 (JMJD2 inhibitor) samples are excluded as a perturbation.
MCF7 cancer cells with control or Linc-ASEN siRNA only; the series does not state that either sample is senescent, so there is no senescent condition and no stated proliferating control.

The profiled cells are prostate cancer lines (PC3, DU145) exposed to EVs from stromal cells; the senescent cells (bleomycin-treated stromal cells) are the EV source and are not sequenced. No sample is a senescent cell sample.

Series text does not state an explicit senescence assay; the bleomycin-only group is taken as senescent because the series describes cells manifesting a typical SASP after DNA damage. The shared treatment protocol mentions ML324, but the sample fields name SB203580, CCCP, STING deficiency and RU.521 as co-treatments.
Senescence is induced by IDH1 knockdown (shIDH1), and the series text states it induces senescence, but no senescence assay is named in the fields. The control is an unspecified control infection.

Only a 24 h doxorubicin exposure after release from contact inhibition is studied, and the series never says senescence was reached, so doxorubicin samples and their 0 nM controls are unclear. RB1/p130 knockout samples are excluded as perturbations.

confirmation_stated: SA-β-galactosidase activity, increased CDKN2A/p16, cell cycle arrest in G2/M, interleukin 8 production
note: The senescent condition is a knockdown of all three H2A.Z isoforms in the PANC-1 cancer cell line (PZT-2), compared with wild-type PANC-1. The inducer is the knockdown itself, which is not a standard inducer.
HeLa cancer cells with XAB2 knockdown for splicing analysis; no senescence induction or senescent condition is described, so all samples are excluded.

Controls are non-transduced BJ-TERT cells (described as proliferating in the series title/summary); the senescent condition is myrAKT1 transduction at 6 days. No senescence marker assay is stated in the series fields.
BJ-TERT (hTERT-immortalised) fibroblasts; senescence is induced by HRASG12V and the series calls the 14-day HRAS samples senescent. The 'cell type' field holds replicate numbers, not a cell type.

The series text does not name the senescent OIS time point; all 4-OHT-induced samples (D2-D10) are labelled senescent because their source_name says 'Oncogene induces senescent', although D2-D6 could be intermediate. The siDNMT1 samples are excluded as perturbed.

Keratinocyte growing vs PMA-differentiated dataset with no senescent condition; senescence was studied in a separate fibroblast dataset. Growing samples are labelled proliferating, differentiated samples are excluded.

Eight senescence models (IR, doxorubicin, HRASG12V, replicative) in four cell types, each with its own control; the time of collection after induction is not stated. Controls are untreated cells at low PDL (control_kind for proliferating controls set to early passage or young).
All samples are MCFDCIS xenograft tumours from mice, not cultured cells. The summary says palbociclib induced senescence in MCFDCIS cells, but the tumour samples are not labelled senescent.

HCT116 cancer cells with CRISPR TP53 exon 11 mutants, with or without 24 h doxorubicin. No sample is stated to be senescent (senescence is only a proposed consequence of p53beta). GSM3775856 and GSM3775857 are titled as WT replicates 2 and 3 but their source_name says mutant, so they are unclear.

Recipient HFFF2 fibroblasts were treated with sEV from iRAS or iC cells. The sample codes (C, DS, DRS, OS, ORS; 1 vs 2) are not defined in the fields, so the conditions and the senescent state of each sample cannot be decided. All samples are labelled unclear.

The senescent condition is a 'senescence-like dormant state' of drug-tolerant EGFR-mutant NSCLC cells after 2 weeks of osimertinib plus trametinib. The summary names no senescence marker, and the labels rely on the series calling this state senescence-like.

Cells were collected only 24 h after osimertinib+trametinib, while the senescence-like dormant state is described for longer treatment; no sample is stated to be senescent. OT samples and their DMSO controls are labelled unclear, and YAP1 KO samples are excluded as perturbations.

Series says continuous passaging induced replicative senescence but names no passage; P4 (last) is labelled senescent, P0 as early-passage control, P1-P3 as intermediate. Two culture protocols (Tryp-LN-F99 and ColA-ColIV-M4M5) from 7 donors each.

Inducer is read as irradiation from 'IR' in sample titles; the series text never defines IR or gives the time after irradiation. Only the empty-vector DMSO samples are plain senescent or control; Parkin and CCCP samples are excluded as perturbations.

Senescence was induced by irradiation; TSA (100 nM, 10 days) is a perturbation, so TSA-treated proliferating and irradiated samples are excluded. No senescence marker is stated in the series text; the senescent label rests on the 'cell state' field.

SuperSeries with no summary: 24 mouse liver hepatocyte samples from paracetamol-treated mice (no senescence induction) plus 30 IMR90 culture samples. Within IMR90, only the irradiated empty-vector (CCCP/Parkin-free) and irradiated no-TSA samples are plain senescent; Parkin, CCCP and TSA samples are perturbed.

Senescence is only a side observation (increased senescence after IS, assay not named) in an angiogenesis study of 24 h indoxyl sulfate exposure of HUVECs. The series does not say a senescent state was reached, so IS and control samples are unclear.

Single-cell RNA-seq of sorted cells from fresh mouse and human lung tissue (bleomycin fibrosis, IPF, scleroderma, normal); senescence is not mentioned and no senescent condition is defined, so all samples are excluded.

All samples are epithelial cells freshly isolated from human lung tissue (IPF fibrotic region vs donor control), not cultured and not induced to senescence in vitro; senescence is only inferred from scRNA-seq features, so all are excluded.

Senescence is described only in the summary as arising from TGF-β plus RUNX3 loss; no senescence assay is named. Labels assume siRUNX3 + TGF-β is the senescent condition; control siRNA + TGF-β and siRUNX3 without TGF-β are excluded as single-factor conditions.

All samples are early passage hUC-MSCs with KDM3A/KDM4C knockdown or overexpression and their reagent controls. No senescence inducer is applied and no sample is described as senescent, so the controls have no senescent counterpart in this dataset.

Deep senescence (28 days after bleomycin) is treated as senescent, as the series names it a late senescent state. The reversal samples are bleomycin-induced senescent cells with TP53 knocked down by dCas9/KRAB, so they are excluded.
Senescence is induced by RRM2 knockdown (dNTP depletion), not a classical inducer; the shRRM2+shp16 samples are a senescence bypass and are excluded. The summary states no senescence marker assay.

The series calls the H2O2 condition premature senescence but gives no senescence marker in the summary or design. Senescence is therefore taken from the treatment protocol wording, and the 48 h time point is short.
scRNA-seq of human lung biopsies (PF vs non-fibrotic control); no senescence induction or senescent condition, so all samples are tissue and excluded.

Only short Y-27632 exposures (12 h, 48 h) vs untreated were sequenced; the title mentions senescence after long-term treatment, but no sample is stated to be senescent and no senescence assay is given.

All samples are KSHV-infected HMVECs; the mock controls used in the comparisons are not in the dataset. The series says KSHV overcomes replicative senescence, but no sample is stated to be senescent, so the Dvcyc samples are unclear.

Single-cell RNA-seq of cryopreserved whole lung dissociates from control, COPD and IPF donors; no senescence induction or senescent condition is described, so all samples are excluded as not cultured cells.

The series studies HGPS patient fibroblasts versus normal fibroblasts and does not state that the HGPS cells reached senescence, so HGcon and NFcon are unclear. All siRNA and FTI treated groups are excluded as perturbations.

The series describes in vitro ageing of bone marrow MSCs over passages 1-15 but never states that cells became senescent, so all samples are unclear. Two samples (PN251_p15_A, PN241_p10_A) are repeat sequencing runs of other samples.

confirmation_stated: proliferation defects, multi-nucleation and enlargement of cells linked to cytoplasmic microtubule-bundling
note: Senescence is induced by doxycycline-inducible overexpression of PRC1 (wild-type or NLS3A mutant) for 2 days in A549 cells; the series states both give senescence. Non-induced cells of each construct serve as controls.

No senescence is induced or described; all samples are growing IMR-90 cells with control or NSD2 siRNA. Controls are labelled not senescent because the cells are stated to be growing; NSD2 knock-down samples are excluded as perturbations.

No senescence is induced in this dataset: all samples are growing IMR-90 cells with control or NSD2 siRNA. Controls are proliferating cells; NSD2 knockdown samples are perturbations, not senescent samples.
Acute 30 min H2O2 (2 mM) vs water in Jurkat T cells; no senescence is induced or confirmed in this dataset, so none of the samples is labelled senescent or as a control of senescent cells.

The series calls all four stimulus groups senescent (doxorubicin, tert-butyl hydroperoxide, serial passage, RO3306+nutlin3a), and the three drug groups were collected 21 days after treatment. No senescence marker is given in the fields.

Aged vs young donor mobilized peripheral blood cells cultured up to one month; the fields describe donor age, not senescence, so aged samples are unclear and young controls follow them. Restored samples are aged cells co-cultured with young cells (heterochronic transwell).

WS1 fibroblasts with AUF1 knockdown or overexpression versus vector controls; no senescence inducer was applied and no sample is stated to be senescent, proliferating or quiescent, so no sample can be labelled senescent or not senescent.

Only the in vitro osimertinib + trametinib PC-9 sample is a senescent (senescence-like dormant) condition; the three in vivo samples are xenograft tumours and are excluded as not cultured cells. The senescence state is described as 'senescence-like dormant', with no senescence assay stated in the summary.
Blood CD8 T cells from smokers and nonsmokers; no senescence induction or senescent condition in this dataset. Nonsmoker samples are not stated as proliferating or quiescent.
Post-mortem human brain snRNA-seq (Alzheimer's disease vs control); no senescence induction or senescent condition in this dataset, so all samples are excluded as not cultured cells.
Peripheral blood immune cells from smokers and nonsmokers; no senescence induction or senescent condition, and the samples are not cultured cells.

The series never says that late-passage (P6) BMSCs are senescent (only 'in vitro aging'), so P6 and the P3/P4 unstimulated cells are labelled unclear. Cytokine-stimulated (TNF-alpha/IFN-gamma, 24 h) samples are excluded as perturbed.

Recipient IMR90 cells were exposed for 3 days to conditioned medium from IMR90-ER:RAS cells collected at day 0, 4, 7 or 10 after 4-OHT. The fields never say that the recipient cells became senescent, so all samples are labelled unclear. Day 0 medium is the likely control.

Only the adipocytes co-cultured with myeloma cells are described as having a 'senescent-like' phenotype, and no senescence assay is named in the summary, so those labels are tentative. Myeloma cell line samples are not the subject of senescence and are excluded.

The study is about H3K9me3 inhibition, nucleophagy and cGAS signalling, not senescence. No sample is described as senescent, so all samples are excluded. BIX-01294 is not presented as a senescence inducer.

confirmation_stated: percentages of SABG-stained cells; expression of p16, p21 and p53; ICAM-1 expression; tube formation and mobility at late passages
note: All samples are HUVEC at PDL 28 cultured in elderly (EHP) or young (YHP) human plasma; the fields never state that EHP cells are senescent, so EHP is unclear and YHP is treated as a rejuvenation/reversal condition. No proliferating or early-passage control is included.

The summary does not describe any senescence assay. The senescent labels rest on the series title (senescence induced by BMI1 inhibition), and the timing of treatment is not stated. The BMI1 knockdown samples are labelled senescent on the same basis.
All samples are doxorubicin-induced senescent TIG-3 cells, with vehicle or the senolytic ARV825 for 4 days. There is no non-senescent control, and the time since doxorubicin is not given.

SLO is an unnamed senescence-inducing compound. The series gives no senescence marker, and the control treatment (untreated or vehicle) is inferred from the CTR sample titles. The labels rest on the series title and summary saying the compounds induce senescence in post-mitotic neurons.
A375 melanoma cells with SPANX knockdown versus empty vector; no senescence is induced or described, so no sample has a senescent state. Not usable as senescence data.
Oncogene-induced (RAS) senescence in IMR90; the series text gives no senescence marker or time point. The METTL14 knockdown and rescue samples are excluded as perturbations.

SuperSeries with no senescence confirmation in its text; the senescent state rests on sample labels (RAS-induced senescence in IMR90). Knockdown and rescue samples are excluded as perturbations; the shared protocol text mentions METTL14 only, though METTL3 samples are also present.

The summary says BCLAF1 and MED23 depletion induces premature senescence, but no senescence assay is given. The BCLAF1 knockdown is the inducer, so the knockdown samples are labelled senescent on the strength of the summary alone. Titles say siBCLAF1, but the treatment protocol describes shRNA.

No senescence inducer was applied; the comparison is C9orf72-mutant against control iPSC-derived astrocytes at the same passage (up to passage 10). The summary says C9 astrocytes show increased senescence but names no measurement, so all states are unclear.

Aged vs young hADSCs, with rGDF11 treatment of aged cells. The fields never state that the aged cells are senescent, so aged untreated and young samples are unclear. rGDF11-treated samples are excluded as perturbations.

Single-cell RNA-seq of human ascending aorta tissue (normal vs thoracic aortic aneurysm); samples are tissue from organisms, not cultured cells, and no senescence induction was applied. Senescent VSMCs are a cell cluster within TAA samples, not a sample-level condition.

All samples are RAF1-ER oncogene-induced senescent WI38 hTERT cells; there is no proliferating control. Control siRNA samples are the senescent reference, and circANRIL knock-down samples are excluded as perturbations.

Human CD34+ cells were transduced ex vivo, then xenografted into NSG mice and human myeloid cells were sorted from bone marrow after 15 days, so all samples are in vivo-derived and are labelled excluded as not cultured cells. BRAF-V600E GFP+ cells are the senescence-program condition, and GFP- bystander cells of BRAF-V600E mice are also said to show it.
BRAF-induced senescence in BJ hTERT fibroblasts; the control samples are only labelled 'control' (no vector or time details). MIR31HG-KD and YBX1-KD OIS samples are perturbations and are excluded.

Senescence is only mentioned in passing in the summary (radiation-induced senescence); no senescence marker, time point or senescent condition is stated, so all samples are unclear. The study is about macrophage differentiation and HERV expression after 5 Gy.

No chemotherapy or other senescence inducer is applied in this dataset; it only compares siControl with siSTRIP1 MDA-MB-231 cells, so no sample is labelled senescent. STRIP1 loss causes cell cycle arrest, which the series does not call senescence.
Celecoxib-alone and 4-OHT+Celecoxib samples are excluded as drug perturbations; the DMSO 'Growing' samples are the control. Celecoxib dose is 40 uM in the summary but 10 uM in sample fields.

The sequenced cells are LoVo colorectal cancer cells co-cultured (Transwell, 24 h) with HFL1 fibroblasts, not the fibroblasts themselves. No sample is a senescent cell population, so all samples are excluded.

No sample is stated to be senescent: untreated (DMSO) and A83-01-treated eMSC were both harvested at passage 4 after 36 days, and the series only says A83-01 blocks senescence. Sample titles, descriptions (P1_A83neg etc.) and patient ids do not match each other, so pairing by patient is unreliable.

The title mentions therapy-induced senescence, but the summary and design describe dbcAMP-induced differentiation and give no senescence marker or senescent time point. All samples are therefore labelled unclear; the time course covers only 0-48 h, while the design mentions 3 days of treatment.

Senescence is induced by SIRT7 knockout (genetic, no external inducer); the summary describes SIRT7-deficient hMSCs as having senescence phenotypes, but no specific senescence assay is named in the series fields. WT hMSCs at the same passage serve as controls.
Senescence here is induced by ZKSCAN3 knockout (premature aging) in hMSCs at P10, compared with WT; the sample fields report no senescence assay, so the labels rest on the series summary.

Series text is only a SuperSeries stub, so it never states that senescence was reached; ex vivo and scRNA-seq samples are labelled unclear. PDX samples are AML cells harvested from AraC-treated or untreated mice (not cultured) and are excluded.

confirmation_stated: beta galactosidase staining (senescence initially confirmed); failure to divide after at least one week of passaging
note: Replicative senescence in BJ fibroblasts with empty-vector TetOn lines; doxycycline (20 nM) is a vector-control condition and is not treated as a state-changing perturbation. Controls are young, contact-inhibited quiescent cells (<PD35).

confirmation_stated: beta galactosidase staining (senescent cells failed to divide after at least one week of passaging, initially confirmed using beta galactosidase staining)
note: Replicative senescence time course in BJ fibroblasts; only the DMSO samples are plain controls or senescent. Rapamycin, EPZ-5676 and combination samples are drug perturbations and are excluded. Intermediate DMSO is excluded as a pre-senescent time point. All non-senescent cells were contact-inhibited quiescent.

confirmation_stated: beta galactosidase staining (initial confirmation of senescence); cells failed to divide after at least one week of passaging
note: Senescence is replicative (typically after PD64); JMJD6 knockdown samples are excluded as perturbations. Young controls were grown to confluence (contact-inhibited quiescence) before harvest.

confirmation_stated: beta galactosidase staining (stated in the growth protocol: senescence 'initially confirmed using beta galactosidase staining'; not in the series summary)
note: Replicative senescence of BJ fibroblasts, where late-passage (>=PD64) untreated or vehicle cells are the senescent samples. Rapamycin-maintained or rapamycin-withdrawn high-passage arrested cells, drug, ligand and shRNA perturbations, and intermediate PD cells are excluded. Young controls were confluence-arrested (quiescent).

confirmation_stated: SA-β-gal activity, growth arrest, and increased cellular granularity after AraC treatment
note: Primary patient-derived AML cells cultured ex vivo on stroma; the senescence is described as transient, senescence-like. The 3-day AraC time point is assumed senescent because the series describes AraC-treated cells as premature senescent.

confirmation_stated: SA-β-gal activity, growth arrest and increased cellular granularity (stated for AraC-treated primary AML cells in the series summary)
note: All samples are AML cells harvested from PDX mice (in vivo AraC treatment), not cultured cells, so none is labelled senescent or control. The series calls the AraC-induced senescence-like state transient and does not say which time point (day 8 or 29) is senescent.

Senescence is induced by doxycycline-driven GATA6 overexpression in A549 cells (48 h); the series says GATA6 induces senescence but this summary does not give a 48 h senescence assay, so the senescent label rests on the series statement.

The series does not say that palbociclib-treated cells became senescent, so all treated time points are unclear. Log-phase untreated samples are labelled not senescent because they are stated to be growing cells.

The series text never mentions senescence; it describes YAP knockdown and LPS treatment. Passage 3, 6 and 12 samples are labelled unclear because no senescence is stated, and the YAP/LPS samples are not senescence-related.

confirmation_stated: Population doubling time, EdU incorporation and cell cycle by flow cytometry (proliferation measures; no senescence marker such as SA-beta-gal is stated)
note: No sample is stated to be senescent; the study is about rejuvenating high-passage (P15) stem cells with SV40 LT-derived matrix. The P15 TCP sample is the only plausible senescent-like condition, but the fields do not say senescence was reached.

Study of SNCA (alpha-synuclein) overexpression in RA-differentiated SH-SY5Y cells; senescence is only mentioned as an enriched pathway in the RNA-seq results, with no senescence induction or validation stated. No sample is labelled senescent.

This is a SuperSeries about alpha-synuclein (SNCA) overexpression in retinoic-acid-differentiated SH-SY5Y cells. It has no senescence induction or senescent condition, so no sample can be labelled senescent or as a control of senescence.

All samples are RAS-expressing IMR90 cells transfected with a psoralen/biotin miR-146a mimic. Three are input RNA and three are AGO2 miR-CLIP pull-downs, so the pull-downs are not expression profiles of whole cells. There is no proliferating control in the dataset.

All five samples are RAS-expressing IMR90 cells; there is no empty-vector control in the dataset. Control-antagomir samples are labelled senescent, anti-miR-146a samples are excluded as perturbed. The series calls the cells RAS senescent but gives no marker measurement.

SuperSeries with no senescence markers stated. All samples are RASV12-expressing IMR90 at day 10, with no empty-vector control samples in this part. Input and miR-CLIP (AGO2 IP) samples carry a psoralen/biotin miR-146a mimic and are excluded. Anti-146a samples are excluded for the antagomir perturbation. Only the control-antagomir samples are plain RAS-senescent.

Senescent cells are described only as 'senescent' endothelial cells; the inducer (likely replicative) and passage or time are not stated, so inducer is 'not stated'. SA-beta-gal is cited only for the circGNAQ silencing experiments, not for these samples.
This dataset only compares C4-2 cells treated with DMSO or 1nM R1881 (androgen) for 72h; no atraric acid or other senescence-inducing condition is included, so it holds no senescent sample.

All samples are irradiated WI-38 cells harvested 8 days after 10 Gy. Scrambled siRNA samples are the senescent condition, and G3BP1 knockdown samples are excluded as a perturbation. The dataset has no proliferating control, and no senescence marker is given.

The series never states that passage 4 cells are senescent, so no sample is labelled senescent. Passage 4 FGF2+CHAPS and the passage 1 vehicle samples are unclear. Samples treated with WNT3A are excluded as perturbations.
Osteoarthritis joint tissue (synovium and cartilage) profiled by scRNA-seq; no senescence induction or senescent condition in the dataset.

Senescence is induced by dox-inducible p16 or p21 expression for 5 days in MCF10-A cells (not a classical stressor); the summary and design state no senescence marker assay. The p16 + Torin2 samples are excluded as a perturbation (mTOR inhibition), and the mVenus-only samples are the control.

The senescent samples are the 4OHT-induced ER:RAS cells at day 5. The shXPO7 samples are excluded because the knockdown is stated to alleviate senescence. Samples with the same condition are replicates.

The series never mentions senescence; it compares survivin localisation with and without TMZ (50 µM, 48 h) in LN229 cells. No sample is labelled senescent, so all are excluded. TMZ is recorded as the inducer for treated samples only as a nominal DNA-damaging drug.

No senescence was induced or measured; cells were deliberately harvested at passage ~8 to avoid senescence, and the study compares healthy and radiotherapy-sensitive patient fibroblasts. All samples are labelled as having no senescent condition.

Senescence is only stated in the summary for aneuploid (ArCK) cells; doxorubicin, palbociclib, nutlin3 and Torin1 samples are not described as senescent in the fields, so they are unclear. STAT1 KO samples (cycling and ArCK) are excluded as KO perturbations.

Spontaneous (replicative) senescence of primary oral keratinocytes from three donors; 'last' passage is treated as the senescent condition and passage 5 as the early-passage control, while passage 10 is treated as an intermediate time point. The summary mentions senescence assays but does not name them.

No senescence is induced or claimed in these samples (senescence only appears in the mouse Mdm2-deletion model); the series says the cultured hBEC are phenotypically stable. The 10 CD133+/- samples appear to be freshly sorted cells from donor livers, while the P0-P14 samples are cultured in 2D or 3D.
Androgen (R1881) dose study in prostate cancer cell lines; no senescence is induced or studied, so no sample has a senescent condition.
Senescence is replicative (HUVECs prepared as 'young' proliferating vs replicatively senescent); no passage numbers or senescence marker confirmation are given in the fields.

The 3DA + 4OHT samples are excluded because the methyltransferase inhibitor prevents senescence. DMSO samples are vehicle controls of the 4OHT-induced RAS senescence at day 6. No confirmation assay is stated beyond a reference to previous experiments.

Oncogene-induced senescence (4OHT-activated ER:RAS) at 6 days. shAHCY samples are knockdowns that prevent senescence, so they are excluded as perturbations. The non-senescent control is the empty-vector line with DMSO vehicle.

SuperSeries with no summary; the senescent condition is inferred from the 4OHT (ER:RAS) arms and the sample labels 'senescent cells (EV+4OHT)'. 3DA and shAHCY samples are AHCY perturbations in 4OHT-treated cells and are excluded.

Senescence is induced by doxycycline-driven TRF2-DN expression (telomere dysfunction); the series gives no senescence marker measurement. Doxycycline-treated parental A549 cells are a reagent control and were labelled not senescent.

Bleomycin-treated PSC27 are taken as the senescent condition; the series text gives no time point or senescence marker. BLEO/NAD+ and BLEO/NMN samples are excluded as drug perturbations meant to suppress the SASP.

Bleomycin-treated PSC27 are taken as the senescent condition, though no time point or senescence marker is given. BLEO/ALA samples are excluded because ALA is described as killing senescent cells and suppressing the SASP.

All samples are FFPE rectal cancer patient biopsies (104 pretherapeutic) or post-chemoradiotherapy surgical specimens (12), not cultured cells. No senescent condition or senescence measurement is defined for these samples.

Senescence is described only through the bleomycin treatment protocol and the title; no time point or senescence marker is stated. The BLEO/GSE samples received grape seed extract, which the summary describes as killing senescent cells.
Explanted IPF lung tissue dissociated for scRNA-seq; no senescence induction in culture and no senescent or control condition in this dataset.

Senescence is induced by bleomycin (50 μg/ml, 12 h); the fields do not state the collection time or any senescence marker. BLEO/GBE and BLEO/RTE samples are drug-treated (SASP-suppression) and are excluded.

Senescence is not confirmed by any measurement in the series text; the bleomycin samples are taken as senescent because the series calls them senescent cells and the protocol says bleomycin was used to induce senescence. The time point after bleomycin is not stated. Bleomycin/curcumin samples are excluded because curcumin is an added drug.

Senescence is induced by HRAS-G12V in IMR90; no time point or senescence marker is stated. KD (HRAS + shDOT1L) and DOT1L-overexpression samples are excluded as perturbations, although the series groups label KD as senescent with decreased SASP and OE as not senescent.

Senescence is induced by SARS-CoV-2 infection of hPSC-derived DA neurons (virus as inducer, 'other'); the series text states infection caused senescence, but no non-transcript confirmation assay is stated. This is a SARS-CoV-2 infection study of lung organoid cells with no senescence induction or senescence markers. No sample is senescent, so all are excluded as having no senescent condition.

Freshly sorted EPCAM/CD31/CD45-negative mesenchymal cells from explanted healthy and IPF donor lungs, analysed by scRNA-seq. No senescence induction or senescent condition is described, so all samples are excluded.
No senescence induced or mentioned; the dataset compares stem cell types (hESC, embryoid bodies, MSC, derived musculoskeletal stem cells), so there is no senescent condition.

Young, mid-aged and old HUVEC are replicative-aging stages with no passage numbers given. The old samples are called senescent because the growth protocol says cells were cultured until they ceased proliferation, but no senescence assay is stated.

U2OS osteosarcoma cancer cells; the series states the 7-day time point corresponds to senescence but gives no senescence marker. The 90-minute IR samples are an early DNA-damage response, and NFKBIA knockdown samples are unirradiated.

Primary human lung tissue (IPF, SSc-ILD, transplant-rejection controls) sorted by surface markers for scRNA-seq; no senescence induction and no senescent condition is described. Only EPCAM+SAbGAL+/- sorted samples relate to senescence markers, but the series does not call them senescent.

Senescence is oncogene-induced (RAS) in IMR90; the time point is not stated. The shared treatment protocol mentions siMETTL14 and METTL14 constructs, but the sample labels refer to METTL3 knockout and knock-in, so the perturbed samples are excluded.

PSC27 stromal cells were co-xenografted with PC3 cancer cells in mice and treated in vivo, so samples are tissue from an organism. The text does not state that senescence was confirmed in these samples.
The late-passage group is called 'senile' hBMSC (passage 9) and taken as the senescent condition because the series aims to study hBMSC senescence. No senescence marker is reported in the fields.

Late-passage and etoposide samples are both described as senescent; early-passage cells are the control for both. Etoposide samples were taken about 8 days after the start (4 days drug plus 4 days after removal).

Inducer is doxycycline-induced KRAS overexpression (5 days); the series text only says KRAS-induced senescence and gives no senescence assay. ARID1A-KO clones are treated as perturbations, so only the KRAS-WT and non-induced WT samples are usable labels.

All samples are senescent MRC-5 cells (replicative senescence inferred from the series text); empty-vector samples are the senescent condition and TRF2-overexpressing samples are excluded as perturbed. No senescence marker assay is stated in the summary.

Only non-differentiated young (CTR) and senescent (SEN) samples are plain controls/senescent; decidualized samples (day 4, 8) in both groups carry an added differentiation treatment and are excluded. No senescence marker assay is stated in the summary.

Senescence is induced by bleomycin in PSC27 cells, but no time point or senescence marker is given in the fields. BLEO/CCE samples carry an extra cocoa extract treatment aimed at suppressing the SASP, so they are excluded.

Senescence is attributed to DKC1 A386T short-telomere iAT2 cells without naming a time point, so the last time point (Day70) is labelled senescent and earlier mutant time points as intermediate. WT DKC1 A386 samples are isogenic controls at every time point.

HLE-B3 is a lens epithelial cell line, and the 12 h H2O2 treatment is used to study apoptosis and autophagy, not to induce senescence. The dataset holds no senescent condition, so no sample is labelled senescent or not senescent.
HUR overexpression/knockdown study in skin fibroblasts. No senescence induction or senescence readout is described, so no sample can be labelled senescent or control.

Every sample received the Akt inhibitor, which the series says blocks SAL-induced senescence, so the dataset has no plain SAL-senescent sample and no plain untreated control. All samples are labelled excluded (perturbation). SAL = 1 nM R1881, LAL = 1 pM R1881.
Dox-inducible shFbxo22 samples (young and irradiated) are excluded as knock-down perturbations; only shLuciferase samples serve as senescent and young controls. Time after irradiation is not stated.

Replicative senescence time course of two HUVEC clones (5 to 74 days of culture). The series does not name the senescent time point, so the last time point (d74) is taken as senescent and d5 as the young control; d18 to d61 are treated as intermediate.

Senescence is only stated in the summary as a result of RAMP2-AS1 knockdown; the DMSO, atorvastatin and TNFalpha samples are not described as senescence conditions. The label for the knockdown samples rests on one summary sentence with no named assay.

Bleomycin-treated PSC27 are taken as senescent from the treatment protocol (bleomycin 'to induce senescence'); the time point of collection is not stated. BLEO/PCC1 samples received a senolytic and are excluded.
Single-cell atlas of human oral mucosa tissue (healthy and periodontitis); no senescence induction or senescent condition, so all samples are excluded as tissue samples.

Replicative passaging series of oral keratinocytes (passage 5, 10, 'last'). The fields do not say that the 'last' passage reached senescence, so all samples are labelled unclear; if the 'last' passage is taken as senescent, p5 would be the early-passage control and p10 an intermediate time point.

Anti-senescence drug study on P8 hMSCs. The fields never say that any sample reached senescence, so the dataset has no senescent condition. The control is untreated cells cultured 21 days, and it is not stated to be proliferating or quiescent.

The series text is only a SuperSeries stub, so no senescence assay or senescent condition is stated. The title suggests pre-miR-340-5p promotes senescence, but the fields do not say it was reached, so those samples and their controls are unclear.

THP-1 samples (conditioned medium from VIS fibroblasts, CD86+/CD86- fractions) are labelled unclear because the fields do not say which fraction is senescent. WI-38 fibroblasts with siRNA knockdowns of YAP/TAZ, cGAS and STING only. No senescence inducer and no senescent condition is described, and the controls are not stated to be proliferating or quiescent, so every sample is excluded.

CRISPR screen follow-up in teloHAEC with no senescence induction and no senescent condition; all samples are sgRNA-targeted or safe-harbor control cells, so none can be labelled senescent or confirmed as proliferating. Cas9 samples also had 4 h TNFa.

CRISPR perturbation study of coronary artery disease loci in teloHAEC endothelial cells; no senescence induction or senescent condition, so all samples are excluded. Cas9 samples were also treated with TNFa for 4 h.

Dataset compares fetal GPCs sorted by A2B5 or CD140a from second-trimester brain. It has no senescence induction and no senescent samples. The cells were kept in culture 1-14 days after sorting, but they are primary cells taken from tissue.
Doxorubicin (500 nM, 5 days) samples are taken as senescent because the series calls them senescent cultures. No senescence marker measurement is stated in the series text.

confirmation_stated: positive staining for senescence-associated beta-galactosidase activity
note: Three cell types (BEC, SAEC, and a third type not in this message) with doxorubicin or H2O2 induction; time after induction is not stated. DMSO controls serve as vehicle controls.

The inducer of senescence is not named in the series text. Day 5 and Day 12 are described as culture times of senescent cells, so they may not be times after induction. Samples are grown on Matrigel or tissue culture plastic.

SuperSeries mixing cultured airway epithelial cells (doxorubicin, H2O2, Matrigel/plastic senescence models) with ILD patient BAL, biopsy, digest and explant-sorted samples. Doxorubicin and H2O2 samples are not stated to be senescent in the fields, so they and their DMSO controls are unclear.
Study of COX4I1 knockdown in HFF fibroblasts; it has no senescence induction or senescent condition, so no sample can be labelled senescent or as a control of senescence.

Ribo-seq/input of HCT116 cells after only 4 h neocarzinostatin; the series studies p53-dependent translational regulation after DNA damage and never states that senescence was reached, so no sample is labelled senescent. Samples are Input (mRNA) or ribosome-footprint libraries.

confirmation_stated: increased beta-galactosidase activity, increased p16 levels, telomere markers and ROS levels in DS cells (immunohistochemistry of thymic tissue)
note: All samples are sorted cells from frozen primary thymus of healthy donors or Down syndrome patients, with no senescence induction in culture. Down syndrome is described as showing premature senescence, but this is an in vivo disease state, so all samples are excluded.

Human skeletal muscle biopsies (bulk and single-nucleus RNA-seq) from young, old and sarcopenic subjects; no senescence induction in culture. The CDKN1A-expressing nuclei are only a subpopulation and are not a separate sample.

The fields never state that any sample is senescent; the dataset only compares siControl with PRPF19 knockdown in TIG-3 cells 3 days after transfection. No senescence inducer or senescence assay is described.

Senescence here is a subpopulation of cells within decidualized assembloids (identified by single-cell clustering), not a whole-sample state, so Day 4 samples are labelled unclear and Day 0 samples inherit that. Dasatinib (senolytic) samples are excluded.
Human cartilage tissue from non-arthritic donors and OA patients; no senescence induction or senescent condition in the dataset, so all samples are excluded as not cultured cells.
Series states bleomycin-induced senescence at 10 days; no senescence marker assay is stated in the summary or design. Controls are untreated IMR90 cells.

confirmation_stated: SA-βGal activity measured with a fluorogenic substrate by flow cytometry; features of telomere dysfunction and p16-mediated senescence; impaired proliferation
note: Freshly isolated blood CD8+ T cells, not cultured. Senescent cells are FACS-sorted SA-βGal-high fractions, and the SA-βGal-low fractions from the same donors serve as controls. A549 lung cancer cells with USP2-AS1 knockdown versus control shRNA; senescence is not induced or mentioned, so the dataset has no senescent condition.

Target cells are primary LSECs exposed to conditioned medium from senescent IMR90 (RIS, NIS, N+RIS); the LSECs themselves are not stated to be senescent, so treated samples are excluded and Grow samples are the control medium. Brain and Universal Human Reference RNA samples are commercial reference RNAs, not cultured cells.

confirmation_stated: Slower proliferation and a larger fraction of tetraploid cells in the DAC-derived clone H3-32 (not measured in the sequenced bulk sample)
note: Senescence is claimed only for a cloned DAC-treated line (H3-32), not for the bulk DAC-treated cells that were sequenced, so both samples are unclear. The DAC sample was harvested on day 7 after treatment on days 1 and 3.

Human vastus lateralis muscle biopsies from patients with and without cirrhosis; no senescence induction, so no senescent condition in the dataset. Senescence is only mentioned as an enriched pathway.

Sample titles carry the condition (Ctr, Dox1d, Dox21d, RS); X2-X5 appear to be four replicate sets. Dox1d is an early doxorubicin time point and is excluded as intermediate. The controls are not described in more detail than 'control cells'.

Brain organoids with doxycycline-induced Klotho overexpression versus untreated at week 13; no senescence inducer was applied and no sample is described as senescent or as a proliferating/quiescent control.

All four samples are IMR90 with NTC or HMGB1 siRNA. No sample is stated to be senescent or proliferating; the overall design wording about proliferating or senescent cells is garbled and does not assign a state to any sample. Cells were at early passage (passage 5) at the start.
Ribo-seq series (sample titles end in _rna); senescent samples are replicatively exhausted IMR90 and controls are proliferating IMR90. The fields state no senescence marker measurement.

SuperSeries with two parts: an HMGB1 siRNA knock-down in IMR90 (NTC controls at passage 5, not stated proliferating) and replicative-exhaustion proliferating vs senescent IMR90 total RNA. No senescence confirmation assay is stated in the fields.

The series says AA induces senescence in CRPC cells, but this RNA-seq set is a 72h treatment with DMSO, R1881 and AA; no senescence assay is named for these samples. The AA-only label rests on the summary statement and is less certain.
Primary CTB and EVT cells freshly isolated from first-trimester and term placentae (MACS-sorted); no senescence induction or senescent condition is present, so all samples are labelled excluded.

Study of iPSC-derived CTLs versus primary T cell subsets and NK cells; no senescence induction or senescent condition anywhere. The T cell subsets and NK cells are probably sorted from donors (source not stated), the iPSC-CTLs are cultured.

Senescence is described only through the treatment protocol (bleomycin 50 µg/ml for 12 h) and the series title; no senescence marker is reported and the collection time is not given. GBE and RTE samples also received bleomycin and are excluded as perturbed.
Single-cell RNA-seq of clonal HRAS:G12V-4OHT-inducible lung fibroblasts. Navitoclax (senolytic) samples are excluded. No senescence marker assay is named in the series text.
Patient LCH lesion samples (scRNA-seq of tumour tissue); no in-culture senescence induction and no control samples. Senescence is only a transcriptional signature in the summary.

Senescence is induced by NCOR1 knockdown (shNCOR1_655) in colorectal cancer cell lines, and the summary only says cells stopped proliferating with senescence characteristics, with no specific assay named. Controls are non-targeting shRNA cells.

Adipose stem cells from old, diabetic and young donors were compared. Senescence was not induced or confirmed, so there is no senescent condition. Each donor has a separate sample for miRNA and for mRNA/lncRNA/circRNA. Culture is inferred from the cell type, not stated.

Samples 1-18 are hPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons (mock vs SARS-CoV-2 infected, DMSO/drug-treated); 19-33 are FFPE autopsy midbrain tissue and are not cultured cells. Senescence in infected neurons is the series' claim (inflammatory/senescence response), with no non-transcript confirmation stated in the fields.

Bulk RNA-seq and scRNA-seq samples are mixed. The series does not name which time points are senescent, so only the 'RS late senescent time course' samples are labelled senescent. GSM5340976 is titled hTERT_TP7_C but its cell line field says WI-38, and it is treated as hTERT.

confirmation_stated: Self-renewal ability, reduced P16 and P21 aging markers, and high total and mitochondrial ROS levels rescued by GA (methods not specified).
note: No healthy control is included. The DMSO-treated WS and HGPS hMSCs are labelled senescent because the series treats them as the premature-aging, senescent model. Cord blood CD34+CD38- cells cultured 9 days with 3DA or DMSO; no senescence inducer was applied and no senescent condition exists, so all samples are labelled excluded. Senescence is only mentioned as something 3DA may prevent.

Senescence is not induced experimentally: OA-MSC are labelled senescent only through the cell-type field, and no senescence assay is stated. nCSC are normal-tissue cells used as the comparator. OA chondrocytes are a different cell type with no stated senescence status.

Cultured human donor islets (two donors, 3 replicates per condition) treated with bleomycin or DMSO; the text says senescence can be induced but gives no senescence marker measurement. Bleomycin samples were harvested about 6 days after the start of treatment (48 h drug plus 4 days drug-free).

PSC27 stromal cells were cultured, mixed with PC3 cells and xenografted into mice. The samples are stromal cells laser-microdissected from tumours after 8 weeks of in vivo treatment, so they are not cultured cells. The fields do not state that the MIT samples reached senescence.

confirmation_stated: Decreased capacity of proliferation, differentiation and immunoregulation of MSCs at P4–P12 (no specific assay named)

The series text does not state that DXR treatment produced senescence in RPE-1 cells (no marker given), so DXR and control samples are labelled unclear. The knockdown samples (siMondoA, siMlx) are excluded as perturbations.

Senescence is induced by ADAR1 knockdown (shRNA) in IMR90, not by a classical stressor; the series text says the knockdown is sufficient to drive senescence, but no time point or senescence marker is given for these samples. Senescence is induced by RO3306 (CDK1 inhibitor) plus Nutlin-3a (p53 activator), classed as 'other' inducer. The treatment time is not stated, and no senescence marker assay is named in the series text.

Time course of only 2-24 h after 10 Gy; the series never mentions senescence or any senescence marker, so irradiated samples and their non-irradiated controls are labelled unclear (acute radiation response).

Replicative-lifespan time course of fibroblasts with chronic drug treatments; the fields never state that senescence was reached, so untreated lifespan samples are labelled unclear and treated samples are excluded as perturbations. Contact-inhibition samples are quiescent controls (day-0 samples are unclear); SURF1 patient lines named in the summary are not in this message.

Replicative-lifespan time course (passages) of primary fibroblasts; the fields never say which passage is senescent, so untreated lifespan samples are unclear and treated samples (DEX, mitoNUITs, oligomycin) are excluded as perturbations. Late passages with ~0 doublings may be senescent but this is not stated. Time course of at most 24h after DOX-induced BRAFV600E in RPE-hTERT cells with ERK inhibitor doses; no time point is stated to be senescent, so the dataset has no senescent condition. Untreated controls are excluded for that reason, and DOX samples are excluded as early or perturbed.

Two systems: IMR90 fibroblasts with p16 overexpression (senescence by p16, inducer labelled other) and primary keratinocytes with HRASG12V (oncogene-induced senescence); each has an empty-vector control. No time after induction is stated.

Senescent samples are replicatively senescent MRC-5 (growth plateau); the first six samples are reanalyses of earlier GSM samples. TRF2 overexpression and LMNB1 knockdown samples are excluded as perturbations.

SuperSeries with no time points or senescence markers stated; senescent labels rely on the treatment protocol saying senescence was induced by p16 overexpression (IMR90) or HRASG12V (keratinocytes). Controls are empty-vector cells.

Human BM-MSCs differentiated to osteoblasts with lean, obese or T2D serum; no senescence induction or senescent condition in this dataset (senescence findings in the summary concern mouse bone defects).
USP7 knockdown in melanoma PDX-derived cells harvested 48 h after infection; no senescence induction or senescence marker is described, so no sample can be labelled senescent or as a control.

These 12 samples are only the HDAC4 overexpression/knockdown transfections and their controls in untreated fibroblasts. The UV- or H2O2-induced senescent samples mentioned in the summary are not in this dataset.

The series does not say that ribociclib-treated cells became senescent, and no senescence marker is given, so all samples are unclear. MCF-7 C1 and C8 are ER-mutant derivative lines, each with its own vehicle control.

The series does not name which passage is senescent; I took the last passage group of each genotype (AT R3, WT R5) as senescent and the intermediate passages (R2, R3 and R4 of WT, R2 of AT) as excluded. R1 samples are treated as early-passage controls. IR WT samples are the stated positive control. No senescence assay is given in the series text.
The series is about cigarette smoke extract damage in HK-2 cells and never mentions senescence, so no sample is a senescent condition. All six samples are labelled excluded for that reason.

Despite the title mentioning senescence, the series describes ferroptosis induction (RSL3, Fer-1) in MM1R/MM1S myeloma cell lines over 3 hr, with no senescent condition or senescence assay. All samples are therefore excluded.

The series never says that MAK683 made the cells senescent (only SASP gene derepression and lower Ki67 are mentioned), so cell-line samples are unclear. Xenograft tumour samples are not cultured cells. The A2780D6 samples are listed as A2780 in the cell line field.

Series text never mentions senescence; it is a PRC2 (EED) inhibitor MAK683 study, so cell-line samples are labelled unclear. In vivo samples are xenograft tumour tissue, excluded as not cultured cells. The 3 or 6 day duration is not assigned to specific samples.
Human BPH tissue digested for scRNA-seq; no senescence induction or senescent condition in the dataset. CSP samples are antibody-derived tag (CITE-seq) libraries.
Huh7 hepatocellular carcinoma cells treated with MAT2A or BET inhibitors; no senescence is induced or reported, so no sample is senescent and the vehicle controls are not stated to be proliferating.

Passage 42 FHL124 is described only as a 'cellular aging model'; no senescence marker or statement that senescence was reached is given, so late-passage samples and their passage 15 controls are labelled unclear.

confirmation_stated: deficits in cellular migration and proliferation observed in NPCs harboring T21
note: No sample is explicitly described as senescent: T21 NPCs are called senescence-like (similar to senescent cells, correlated with oxidative stress senescence DEGs), so T21 and euploid NPCs and iPSCs are labelled unclear. Dasatinib+quercetin samples are excluded as senolytic treatment.

The senescent state of the mitoxantrone samples rests on the series' statement that chemotherapy-induced senescence was shown with a multi-marker workflow, and the markers are not named. The 48 h treatment is short.

Cancer cell line (NCI-H292) treated with mitoxantrone for 48 h; the summary says chemotherapy-induced senescence was shown by a multi-marker workflow but names no specific assay. The senescent label rests on the series' general statement, and 48 h is a short time for senescence.

The series text is only a SuperSeries stub; the title mentions immunogenic senescence but no field states that 48 h of 50 nM mitoxantrone gave senescent cells, so all samples are labelled unclear (DMSO samples are the vehicle controls of these).

The title mentions a paracrine senescence loop, but the summary and design only describe mRNA changes 2 days after HCMV infection and do not say that senescence was reached. Infected and mock samples are therefore labelled unclear.

Cal33 xenograft tumours explanted from nude mice after 5 days of fractionated irradiation ± metformin; no senescence is claimed or measured, so all samples are labelled excluded as not cultured cells.
Study of LINC02569 knock-down in cultured primary nucleus pulposus cells; no senescence induction or senescent condition is described, so all samples are labelled excluded.

The sequenced cells are H292 lung cancer cells cultured 48 h with conditioned medium from CAFs or from irradiated senescence-like CAFs. The senescent cells (the CAFs) were not sequenced, so no sample is senescent.

Senescence is induced by culture on stiff (40 kPa) hydrogel versus soft (1 kPa); the summary says mechano-stress promoted senescence but does not name a marker or time point for these RNA-seq samples, so the 40 kPa label is inferred from the series framing.

Patient-derived AML xenograft cells recovered from mice, not cultured; the series does not define a senescent condition (senescence-associated signature is only mentioned for persisting LSCs), so all samples are excluded.
Study of 2D vs 3D dynamic culture of bone marrow MSCs for EV production; no senescence was induced and no senescent sample exists. Senescence appears only as a downregulated pathway in 3D aggregates.

Primary AML patient bone marrow/blood samples (diagnosis, post-chemotherapy day 14/30, relapse), not cultured cells; no senescence induction or confirmation is stated. The message lists 31 of 33 samples.

Neuroblastoma SH-SY5Y overexpression study of SNCA and SNCA-AS1 (Parkinson's/synapse focus); senescence is only mentioned as a speculative implication. No senescent samples, no empty-vector or untreated controls, and no senescence markers measured.

The dataset only compares CUX1 siRNA with scrambled siRNA in primary arterial endothelial cells; no senescence inducer was applied and no sample is described as senescent or proliferating, so no sample can serve as a senescent or control sample.
HTRA1 overexpression study in ARPE-19 cells with no senescence induction or senescence readout; all samples are labelled excluded because the dataset has no senescent condition.

Day 5 and day 8 ER:RAS siNTP samples are both labelled senescent because the treatment field calls them oncogene-induced senescence, but the series does not name the senescent time point. siCASP4 samples are knock-downs and are excluded; ER:STOP controls exist only at day 5.

Replicative senescence of primary prostate epithelial cells; the series text does not state a direct senescence assay (e.g. SA-beta-gal), only that cells were taken through passages until they senesced.
SuperSeries with no confirmation assay in the summary; senescence is defined by late passage (replicative) vs early passage active cells, per sample descriptions.

The six samples are iPSC-derived macrophage progenitor lines (DS vs control genotype is not stated in the fields). Senescence is studied in chimeric mouse brain microglia, not in these samples, so none is senescent.

The series text is only a SuperSeries stub, and no sample states a senescent condition or any senescence marker. Six samples are cultured iPSC-derived progenitors and four are cells from human-mouse chimeric brains (scRNA-seq) injected with tau.
The series never says that MCV LT induces senescence, so LT and dMUR samples and the empty-vector controls are labelled unclear. The p21 knockdown samples are excluded as an added perturbation.

Samples are GFP-sorted cells from PC3 xenograft tumours in NRG mice, not cultured cells. All carry a TIMP1 shRNA and docetaxel; two also got senolytic/BH3-mimetic drugs, and there is no untreated control in the dataset.

Senescence is only stated in the summary as a reversible state of the drug-tolerant persister cells (gemcitabine plus Torin 1, 9 days); no senescence assay is named. Torin 1-only samples are a single-drug arm with no stated senescence, and recovery samples are the reversal.

confirmation_stated: decreased SA-β-gal staining (SA-β-gal positive cell rate) with oridonin; doxorubicin model compared by SA-β-gal positive cells
note: Senescent label for the doxorubicin 'model' group is based on the series calling it doxorubicin-induced senescence (12 h doxorubicin then 48 h DMSO). Oridonin-treated samples are an anti-senescence intervention and are excluded.

Single-cell RNA-seq of EpCAM+ cells from human lung tissue (healthy donors vs IPF patients); no senescence induction or senescent condition, so all samples are tissue-derived and excluded.

Two of the ten samples are surgical breast skin tissue (young and old), excluded as not cultured cells. The senescent state of the 27-passage fibroblasts is only labelled as 'senescent induced' and no marker confirmation is given.

Only the A549 CFI-400945 sample is a clear senescence-inducer sample (CFI-400945 is listed among the senescence inducers). NEO2734 (a BRD2/BET inhibitor in this study) and SASP medium are not named as inducers, so those samples are excluded. No senescence marker is stated in the summary.

Dataset is human gastric cancer tissues and paired adjacent non-tumor tissues; no senescence induction in these RNA-seq samples (senescence only mentioned for in vitro silencing assays not in this dataset).

No senescence induction or senescent condition in this series; it compares WT and CCAR2-/- MDA-MB-231 cells with and without hypoxia. Senescence is only mentioned as a function of CCAR2 in the summary.

Ex vivo organ-cultured human hair follicles (not dissociated cell culture); the summary only says senescence parameters were in line with grey hair, without naming an assay, so the senescent label for 5G is weakly supported. Baseline is freshly isolated, uncultured follicles.

RBM4 knockdown study in A549 and H1299 lung cancer cells with no senescence induction or senescent condition; all samples are labelled excluded. H1299 sample descriptions mention RBM5, probably a typo.

Ph-like ALL PDX cells from mouse spleens, control vs ruxolitinib time course; no sample is declared senescent (senescence is only mentioned as a sub-population in single-cell work), so all samples are labelled excluded as not cultured cells.
