Single sample: unfractionated small RNA (no antibody) from RAS-induced senescent WI-38; the series has no non-senescent control and no time point. Senescence is taken from the title and series wording only.

confirmation_stated: SA-β-gal-positive cells; protein markers p16, p21 and p53 (reduced by CS); EdU/proliferation assays implied (CS promoted proliferation)

Cells were treated with recombinant SASP factors (IL-6, TGFB1, EGF) for 6 h; no senescence was induced and no senescent cells were profiled, so every sample is excluded. PBS samples are vehicle controls of cytokine treatment, not senescence controls.

Senescence is not confirmed by any stated assay in the summary or design; the senescent label rests on the series title and the 'Sen' sample names. Engineered tonsil-derived fibroblast line (CD40LG and BAFF expressing); controls are untreated.

The series mentions senescence but does not say that senescence was induced or reached in any sample. Mn-Tyr is a treatment (possibly anti-senescence), and the controls are not stated to be proliferating or young.

The series studies NPC1-mutant versus healthy fibroblasts with Fingolimod; it contains no senescence induction and no senescent samples (only a transcriptomic aging score), so all samples are labelled excluded.
Senescence here is induced by OGDH knockdown (shOGDH) in HT29 colon cancer cells, per the summary; shNT is the control. The fields name no senescence assay and no time point.

Dataset is mainly ChIP-seq of Polycomb proteins in young fibroblasts (30 population doublings); the RNA-seq samples have no senescent condition. The shared treatment protocol mentions CBX7 shRNA infection, but it is unclear whether these samples were infected.
Ras-induced senescence in WI38 fibroblasts 5 days post-infection; controls are proliferating cells infected with empty vector. No senescence confirmation assay is stated in the series text.
SuperSeries with minimal text; senescence status comes from the sample 'status' field. Time after Ras induction is not stated.

RNA-seq and Ribo-seq samples are mixed in one dataset. SuperSeries mixing RNA-seq and ribosome profiling (rp) samples. Two-sample dataset: uninfected melanocytes (control) vs BRAF V600E lentivirus-infected melanocytes, collected 2 weeks post infection when cells were stated to be fully senescent. No specific confirmation assay named.

All samples are untreated human melanoma cell lines with no senescence induction and no senescent condition in the dataset; none is stated to be proliferating or quiescent (only harvested at 80% confluence).

SuperSeries with minimal text; senescence of BRAF-infected melanocytes is only stated as 'confirmed fully senescent' without the assay. The seven melanoma cancer cell lines are not matched controls and are labelled excluded (other).

Oncogene-induced senescence by 4-OHT-activated RAS:ER in IMR90; the induction time is not stated and no senescence marker is given in the series text. GSM1277019 is typed 'IMR9' in the cell type field, apparently a typo for IMR90.
Only two samples (one proliferating PD38, one senescent PD79); the series text gives no senescence confirmation assay, the senescent label rests on the 'RS_Senescent' growth protocol.
SuperSeries with no detail in the summary; labels rely on the sample growth protocol (RS_Proliferating vs RS_Senescent) and population doubling. No senescence confirmation assay is stated.
Replicative senescence model: PD32 proliferating vs PD88 senescent IMR90, two replicates each. No senescence marker assays are stated in the series text.
No senescence induction or senescent condition in this dataset; it compares blood- and lymphatic-specific endothelial colony forming cells (passage 8 to 15), so all samples are excluded.

The fields describe only IMR90 cells with luciferase or macroH2A1 shRNA knock-down. They name no senescence inducer, senescent condition or proliferation state, so no sample can be labelled senescent or as a control.

Senescence is induced either by ER:RasV12 activation with tamoxifen or by overexpression of cleaved H3.3 (inducer labelled 'other'). The day 3 H3.3 sample is treated as intermediate and excluded. The summary does not name a senescence marker as confirmation.
The fields do not name the inducer; replicative senescence is inferred from the 'young' versus 'late' labels. The p38MAPK inhibitor (SB203580) samples are excluded as perturbations.
Senescence is named by sample source ('senescent cells') and the series title; no confirmation assay (e.g. SA-beta-gal) is stated in the fields. Controls are proliferating pre-senescent astrocytes.

No sample is described as senescent: H2O2 was a 10-minute acute stress used to study replication stress, and the series does not report that senescence was reached. Patient (SLE, AGS) and wild-type fibroblasts are compared, so the untreated samples are not labelled as controls of senescence.

Late-passage (P13) MSCs are described as within the last 3-5 passages before entering senescence, so the senescent state is not clearly reached; early-passage P4 samples are controls of these and are therefore unclear too.

LFS MDAH041 fibroblasts (p53-mutant). Induced-senescence and quiescence samples are made from spontaneously immortal cells (passage >200). The aging (PD17-19) group is treated as an intermediate time point, and the immortal cells as an escape from senescence.
Senescence is induced by 4OHT-activated ER:RAS (7 days). The ZFP36L1wt and ZFP36L1mut samples are overexpression perturbations and are excluded. The cell line name is spelled 'IRM90' in the fields.

Replicative senescence in five fibroblast lines. Only the earliest and latest passages of each line are labelled as control or senescent. HFF and MRC-5 intermediate passages (including the 'old_1' groups PD64 and PD62) are excluded because the fields do not say they are senescent.

The series never names which population doublings are senescent; it only says cells were grown 'from young PD till senescent'. Labels assume the lowest PD without rotenone is young control and the highest PD without rotenone is senescent, which is an assumption. All rotenone-treated samples are excluded as a perturbation.

Heart tissue from mouse (cardiac Bmi1 knockout vs wild type) and human (dilated cardiomyopathy vs control); no senescence induction or senescent condition, so all samples are excluded as not cultured cells.

Senescence is induced by CSL knockdown (siRNA), harvested 3 days after transfection; the summary states that CSL knockdown induces senescence but names no marker assay for this dataset. Inducer is labelled 'other' because CSL loss is not a standard oncogene or drug inducer.
Primary dermal fibroblasts at passage 5 with control or CSL siRNA; no senescence inducer or senescent condition is described. The series text is only a SuperSeries placeholder.

Patient AML samples (bone marrow, blood, leukapheresis) with no senescence induction or senescent condition; the message holds 151 of 452 samples. Immortalized BEAS-2B cells that the series says evade senescence. No sample is described as senescent, and no senescence marker is reported. NUPR1 knockdown is said in the summary to induce premature senescence in vitro, but the RNA-seq samples are not stated to be senescent and no time point or senescence marker is given, so states are unclear. Replicates are single-end and paired-end libraries of the same condition.

ER:RAS IMR90 cells, 6 days of treatment. NIS (N1ICD overexpression without 4-OHT) and RNIS (N1ICD plus RAS) are described by the series as senescence. The series text states no senescence marker.

SuperSeries mixing two sub-series: ER:RAS IMR90 with control vector or N1ICD (NIS/RNIS/RIS/Control) and a RIS/DDIS/Control series. Replicative senescence model (WI-38, PDL 21 young vs PDL 60 senescent). Two RNA fractions: whole cells and mitoplast (mitochondria-enriched), so mitoplast samples are not standard whole-cell transcriptomes. No senescence confirmation assay is stated.

Only the shRen (control hairpin) no-treatment and DMSO samples are labelled senescent or not senescent. All knockdown (Brd4, p65, p53, p53/Rb, p16/p21) and JQ1 samples are excluded as perturbations, including the proliferating and quiescent ones. Quiescent controls were made by 4 days in 0.1% FBS.

SuperSeries of IMR90 cells with HRASV12 oncogene-induced senescence (day 12), proliferating and quiescent empty-vector controls, each with shRNA knockdowns (p53, p65, BRD4, p16/p21, p53/Rb) or JQ1/DMSO. Dedifferentiated liposarcoma cell line LS8817 with cycling (untreated), serum-starved quiescent, and two senescence inducers (doxorubicin, PD0332991), all treated 7 days. The summary and design state no senescence marker measurement.

ARID1B overexpression in IMR90 is said only to induce senescence-response genes; the series does not state that senescence was reached, so both groups are unclear. No senescence marker is reported.
Senescence is inferred from the series title (oncogene-induced senescence); no time point or senescence marker is stated. Most samples carry CRISPR or shRNA perturbations and are excluded.

The series does not name which time point is senescent; BRAF OIS day 10 (last time point) is labelled senescent and day 4 as intermediate. Senescence-bypass samples (SV40 small T plus BRAF) are excluded.

Senescence was induced by 20Gy X-ray and harvested at day 10; CCCP-treated (mitochondria-deficient) senescent samples are excluded as perturbed. No senescence confirmation assay is given in the series text.

SuperSeries with no summary; senescence is inferred from the title (oncogene-induced senescence) and sample labels. BRAF OIS Day 10 is taken as the senescent time point (last one), Day 4 as intermediate; SV40 small T bypass samples are excluded.

Drug-treated breast adenocarcinoma cells (Nutlin-3a, Wip1 inhibitor, both); the summary only says the combination enhanced senescence, with no time point or measurement, so no sample is clearly senescent and all are labelled unclear. Cell line name and treatment duration are not given.

Tumour tissue samples (papillary thyroid cancer central vs invasive regions); no senescence induction or senescent condition in the dataset.
